verdict.rationale: Pulley is a SaaS cap-table and equity-management platform, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of telemetry, analytics, tracking controls or any opt-out mechanism. The docs cover only cap table, fundraising, 409A, liquidity and compliance features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
